instruction: A clean studio photograph in a wide eye-level shot shows a group of cheerleaders standing in a line against a plain white backdrop with soft purple floor lighting. From left to right, the blonde woman (R2), the dark-haired woman (R13), the straight brown-haired woman (R8), the curly-haired woman (R1) in the center, the purple-haired woman (R7), the short black-haired woman (R12), the long brown-haired woman (R9), and the long dark brown-haired woman (R14) stand side-by-side. All wear matching white t-shirts with a "Warsaw Mets" logo and white skirts. They stand facing forward with hands on hips, holding orange pom-poms. The scene is brightly lit with a soft purple ambient glow from below.
elements: R1 is the curly-haired cheerleader positioned in the center of the line
R2 is the blonde cheerleader, not the central curly-haired cheerleader
R7 is the purple-haired cheerleader standing with the group, distinct from central R1
R12 is the short black-haired cheerleader, distinct from R9 who has long brown hair
The cheerleaders face forward with hands on hips
The group is photographed against a plain white studio backdrop with soft purple floor lighting
